layout.concept: High-density dark minimalist control dock with modular collapsible cards and side telemetry drawer.
layout.alignment: Left-aligned monospace readouts with right-aligned numeric telemetry indicators for optimal scannability.

principles: Pure high-contrast dark minimalist terminal UI with strict 44px touch targets. High information density without decorative AI clutter, grounded directly in contracts.ts.

orchestrated_moment.trigger: Fastfetch drawer open / close slide animation (200ms ease-out)
orchestrated_moment.justification: Single deliberate motion moment for system HUD telemetry visibility, keeping all other controls instant and static.
